Primary workload: teacher-facing copilot for lesson planning + inline summarization for student submissions. Also need automated content moderation for student-generated text (profanity, PII detection).

Latency targets: interactive response <800ms average for short prompts (<=256 tokens), acceptable up to 1.5s for multi-step lesson planning. Throughput modest: 20-50 concurrent requests peak (US schools daytime).
Cost sensitivity: very price conscious — pilot budget ~ $500-$1,000/month. Looking for predictable per-token pricing and guidance on batching/caching to reduce spend.
Model preference: open models preferred for cost and auditability; open to Redwood-verified variants. Want ability to pin model version per environment.
Security/compliance: district requires SSO (SAML) for teacher accounts, audit logging on pupil data access. Data retention policy needs to be configurable (30-90 days).
Quote from Sarah: 'We need something lightweight that doesn't blow our budget — and we can't wait months for complex infra.'
